page.layout: One column of dictionary entries in Latin, with Hebrew and some Greek-letter headwords; the text runs the full width of the page. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "Lora-". Running head centred at the top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: Prov.2.15. Hiph. Fut. וְלִיּוּ Recedere faciant, Prov.4.21. euphoniæ causâ pro יליו.
לוּזָת f. Pravitas, Proverb.4.24 : habet formam quasi à לוּז.

לוּחַ m. Tabula: כתֹב עַל־לוּחַ לִבֶּךָ Scribe eas in tabula cordis tui, Proverb.3.3. Plural. לוּחוֹת Tabulæ, Deuteron.9.9. Duale, כָּל לחותַיִם Omnia tabulata, utriusque scilicet lateris, atque adeo quasi gemina tabulata, Ezech.27.5.

לוּט Abscondit, Operuit, Involvit, Obvolvit: quomodo convenit ei לָאַט. Partic. הָלוּט הַלּוּט. Operimenti istius obducti, Jef.25.7. cum Cholem pro הָלוּט: Fœm. לוּטָה Involutus, 1.Sam.21.9. Hiph. Futur. וַיַּלֵּט Et obvolvit, 1.Reg.19.13.

לַט m. Absconsio: Assumto ב advebiascit, בְּלַט Abscondité, Clàm, Ruth.3.7. Et cum Epenthesi, בְּלַאט Clàm, Sensim, Jud.4.21. Plur. לָטִים Incantationes, quòd Occulta sint & occultè fiant, aut fascino oculi spectantium Obvolvantur & Operiantur, ut veram rerum speciem non videant: Affix. בְּלָטֵיהֶם Incantationibus suis, Exod.7.11. בְּלַחְטֵיהֶם Incantationibus suis, Exod.7.11. ubi vide Ab. Esram, pro בְּלַאטֵיהֶם. Apud priscos Hebræorum sapientes legitur: בְּלָטֵיהֶם Id opus est dæmonum: בְּלַחְטָיהֶם est opus præstigiatorum, Cod. Sanhedrin cap.7. fol.67.
לוּט m. Mastiche, Stacte, Ledanum, Genes.37.25. Variant interpretes.
לוּל m. Cochlea: Plur. לוּלִים Cochlea, Gradus cochleares, 1.Reg.6.8. Et fœminininū cum epenthesi, לוּלָאֹת[?]

page.notes: Running head and headwords are in Hebrew; Hebrew forms were copied from the scan and are uncertain where marked [?]. Entry "לוּזָת" and the feminine form at the end of "לוּל" are hard to read. The Hebrew in the "לוּט" and "לַט" entries (including "לָאַט", "הָלוּט", "בְּלַאט" and the forms of "בְּלָטֵיהֶם" group) is small and partly blurred; the vowel points are not fully legible. The catchword "Lora-" is at the lower right. The word "Absconsio" appears with a long s in print and was written with plain s. The first line of the page continues the previous entry, so it is marked cont="true". The page is printed with the Latin typefaces of the period; the printed spelling "fœminininū" is left as printed.
